column2: u8 flags (KF_ENUM_STORAGE u32/s32 locals; u32 map_cell_layer_mask returns)
column10: bit 1 = cell layer[0] (render_world_model lighting layer, collision cache byte offset 0 -> 1), bit 2 = layer[1], 3 both, 0 hidden. The camera visibility grid (build_camera_map_cell_layer_masks) writes the same layer bits plus 0x20 inside the rasterized view polygon, 0x40 camera cell + edge neighbours (render_map_cell_object subdivides) and 0x80 3x3 near ring (clipped enqueue; map objects switch to KF_RENDER_QUEUE_CLIPPED). Records AND their layer bits against the grid. extra_40.bytes[0] of operations 9/21/226 reads the saved_layer view; other operations' bytes[0] is a separate 0/1 latch (split). map_object_set_property(…, 3, 0) varargs are render depths, not layers

double-buffer index toggled by equality (display_next_buffer, KF1), encoded when indexing primitive_buffers/ordering_tables/draw/disp environments; menu frame tests SECOND for the upload rectangle. Named KfDisplayBufferIndex because lib/display.h already owns the OPEN/END KfDisplayBuffer record. Fixed [0]/[1] slot initializers stay array positions (KF1 render.c precedent). 6 literal sites

matrix/svector rotators switch on 0..3; map-cell quarter_turns&3 selects the lighting row light matrix rotations[turn] and the diagonal slide direction (0/2 vs 1/3) in actor and player collision; copy_rotated_fields reduces its angle to the same 2-bit turn. Own header keeps math.h inline helpers out of map_cell_pattern_place (label numbering). Fixed rotations[1..3] slot indices stay array positions. 10 literal sites

column10: menu_window_layouts records 0..6 plus a zero record (KF_MENU_WINDOW_COUNT 8). Window 0 is the root; titles of 1/2 are the glyphs of root rows MEMORY_CARD/OPTIONS and their consumers are menu_run_card_choice/card browsers and menu_options_controller; 3 buy/sell (menu_item_buy_sell_controller, buy/sell lists), 4 stock (menu_item_stock_choice_controller and its two lists), 5 trade (menu_choose_inventory_item, menu_item_trade_controller), 6 the untitled two-row card-browser prompt. KF1 KfMenuWindowKind structure; KF2 bank order differs. menu_window_layout() encodes the table index. 37 literal sites

style selects the number-font glyphs added around the digits (prefix 19; trailing 13; 15,16; 12,18,16; 14,17; trailing 11; 0 none); names keep glyph codes until the number atlas is decoded. Padding 0 fills with the blank glyph 10, 1 with zero digits (KF1 KfFormatPaddingMode). The unsigned (style-1)<2 range test is spelled as equalities; byte-identical. 78 literal sites (39 calls)

column10: same protocol as KF1: -99 loops, confirm yields -choice (0 accept / -1 decline), cancel -1; system-window rows decode as load / quit game / return then save/load/quit titles (panels below 6 titled, 9 zero row); shop buy/sell/return; card browser start/load. Retained as untyped s32 constants: the result channel also carries item and save-slot ids (lane A KfObjectId) and row indices, and E2 typed the confirm flags Boolean. 151 literal sites

each list controller passes its own layout to menu_render_list and menu_preview_choice (forwarded unchanged); the renderer chooses detail/price/count/number columns by mode (3 detail suffix, 2/4 cost, 8/9 card experience+level, 10..15 except 12 price, 16 count+cost). Names follow the controllers (use item 1 ... item magic 16); mode 6 unused. The SHOP_BUY..TRADE unsigned range test keeps its encoded form (equalities change codegen); the 8/9 and 10/11/13/14 ranges read as equalities byte-identically. 44 literal sites

both row tables traverse to an 0xff END row and draw only VISIBLE (1) rows; KF1 shares KfSpriteState across HUD, effect and notification rows. Compass and gauge option bytes are stored into render_model_rows state unchanged (explicit decode boundary; KfPlayerOption is lane A). 45 literal sites

resource_request_transition arguments and resource_selectors are archive entry ids from map data; only the KEEP (0xff) and START_SEQUENCE sentinels, NO_SHIFT offsets and the ACTIVE_NONE/UNINITIALIZED active-slot markers are named (literal calls now use them). Archive slot arguments (0 MO, 3 TALK, 4 VAB, 6 ITEM) use the existing KF_RESOURCE_ARCHIVE_* names; typing the u16/s32 archive parameters is left open because cd_archive_read_chunked's retail (u16) casts would need a double conversion. 33 literal sites

render_color_overlay skips 0xff, shifts control&3 into the quad tpage ABR bits (<<5 | 0x17) and draws at OT depth 1 when bit 0x80 is set (else 0x40); callers fade with 1 (add) and 0x82 (subtract in front) and switch off with 0xff. color_overlay_transition colour/step arguments stay quantities. 17 literal sites

map_object_spawn_effect switches on template byte 1 to pick the drop motion (tip 0x10/0x13/0x16, spin 0x17, bounce 0x11/0x12/0x14/0x15/0x18/0x19/0x20); 0x20 pickup adds tail gold to player gold (GOLD); clearing a 0x10 object's layer sets rotation vz 0x400; other members WIP. 14 literal sites

set_property switches 0 clear layer+state, 1 set layer (vararg), 2 arm event (unknown_38=0xff), 3 render depth (vararg). set_cell_marker 0 hides the object and writes the marker into the cell, 1 shows it and writes 0xfe (KF_MAP_CELL_MARKER_CLEARED). refresh_cell_markers forwards its mode to both (0 hide / 1 restore layer): split into two enums with an explicit decode at that call. 20 literal sites

action 83: 0 run once, 1 run and fall back, 2/3 toggle closed/open (2 runs forward and becomes 3, 3 runs back and becomes 2; save writes only modes >= 2; restore case 9 opens mode 3). Action 88 is a separate 0/1 domain toggled by its marker: 0 restores the source cells after fading back, 1 keeps the alternate cells (E2 hand-off). 15 literal sites

returns 0 for non-marker operations, 1 after consuming a matching marker (key sound), 2 for markers already >= 0xfe, 3 for a different marker (linked notification), 4 for operations 15/17. Marker bytes keep u8: they carry key-item ids (lane A KfObjectId) plus the 0xfe/0xff signals and the bit-0 signal pairs, so only the sentinels are named (MAP_OBJECT_EVENT_TRIGGERED merged). 25 literal sites

execute switches on byte-0xf0: 0 rewind+mark, 2 skip a marker record, 3 skip, 4 call active_table[4], 5 repeat, 6 reset mark, 7 set control byte, 8 rewind, 9 branch on a control byte, 15 end; other bytes are talk pages shown with menu_show_transition_image. Kept as plain constants because the same stream bytes are page numbers and the switch subtracts the base. 10 literal sites
